source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
What this rule allows depends on your [Army Faction](vsdata:core-rule/select-army-faction):

- With **AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM** as your Army Faction, you can pick one of this publication's Detachments in the usual way as you pick your Detachment rules.
- With another Army Faction, if all of your army's models have **IMPERIUM**, your army can also contain **AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM** units, even though they lack the Faction keyword you picked, up to a cap set by [battle size](vsdata:core-rule/select-battle-size).

The caps are:

- Incursion: 1 Retinue, 1 Character and 1 Requisitioned unit.
- Strike Force: 2 Retinue, 2 Character and 2 Requisitioned units.
- Onslaught: 3 Retinue, 3 Character and 3 Requisitioned units.

Such an army can also take **AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM DEDICATED TRANSPORT** units as normal, but each has to begin the battle with at least one unit [embarked](vsdata:core-rule/embarking) in it. One that does not cannot be deployed, and counts as **destroyed** in the first battle round.
